book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Noa tuku ndare
Noa tuku ndare ta teŋenmba. Noa tuku kiŋo keŋmba ande nyunu Sem ande Ham ande Yafet. Kule suŋgo ibeŋ kina le nane keŋ ta kiŋo afu kile-patikinaig.
Yafet tuku ndare

Yafet tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe nyu naŋgine ta teŋenmba. Gomer, Makok, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek, Tiras. Ŋgumneŋga nane tuku ndare tugekinaig sulumba mbuŋ kat naŋgine tuku nyu ta tumba naŋgine tumbraŋ yimyam kilmba minnaig.
Gomer tuku mbuŋ kat nuŋe ta Askenas mbal Rifat mbal Tokarma mbal.
Yawan tuku mbuŋ kat nuŋe ta Elisa mbal Spen mbal Siprus mbal Rodes mbal.
Nane yu make tumba minig mbal le nuy mbolŋge minig mbal ta tuku mbuŋ naŋgine. Yafet tuku ndare ta taŋamba ndo. Nane tuku tumbraŋ yimyam, ma tugu yimyam, pasa mata yimyam.
Ham tuku ndare
Ham tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe nyu naŋgine ta teŋenmba. Kus, Isip, Libia, Kanan. Ŋgumneŋga nane tuku ndare tugekinaig sulumba mbuŋ kat naŋgine tuku nyu ta tumba naŋgine tumbraŋ yimyam kilmba minnaig.
Kus tuku mbuŋ kat nuŋe ta Seba mbal Awila mbal Sabta mbal Rama mbal Sabteka mbal. Rama tuku mbuŋ ta Zeba mbal Dedan mbal.
Kus tuku kiŋo ande nyunu Nimrod. Nimrod nu kame bumba tumbraŋ afu kilke yaika kilmba minna tukunu nu gabat suŋgo mayok kina.
Nu Suŋgoŋge turna le nu kanzerek taŋgo minna. Ta tuku nane afu naŋgine naŋgine teŋenmba sakade. Suŋgoŋge ne turnuwa le kanzerek taŋgo Nimrod suk minamŋgat ŋgade.
O buk Nimrod nu Babilonia kilke ta tuku tumbraŋ keŋmba kulatkina. Tumbraŋ keŋmba ta ande nyunu Babilon ande Erek ande Akad.
Nu Babilonia kilke kusremba Asiria kina sulumba tumbraŋ sugo bailkamba ninde lika wande patike likina. Tumbraŋ sugo ta ande nyunu Nineve ande Rehobot-Ir ande Kala ande Resan.
Resan nu Nineve le tumbraŋ suŋgo Kala ŋgamu-ŋgamuŋge minna.
Isip tuku mbuŋ kat nuŋe ta Lidia mbal Anam mbal Leab mbal Naftu mbal Patrus mbal Kaslu mbal Kreta mbal. Kreta mbal nane Filistia mbal nane tuku mbuŋ naŋgine.
Kanan nu kiŋo armba ŋak minna. Kiŋo mulum ta Sidon ande nyunu Het. Ŋgumneŋga nale tuku ndare tugekinaik sulumba mbuŋ kat naŋgine tuku nyu ta tumba naŋgine tumbraŋ yimyam kilmba minnaig.
Kanan nu Yebus mbal Amor mbal Girkas mbal Hiwi mbal Arka mbal Sini mbal Arwat mbal Semar mbal Hamat mbal nane tuku mbuŋ naŋgine. Kanan tuku tumbraŋ mboŋ nane sili-silinaig le

nane tuku tumbraŋ mboŋ makenu ande kumba ka Sidoŋge tiŋgina le ande kumba ka Gerarŋge tiŋgina. Gerar tumbraŋ ta Gasa tumbraŋ patumba. Tumbraŋ make ki prote kumam kina ta kumba ka Sodom, Gomora, Atma, Seboimŋge tiŋgina. Seboim tumbraŋ ta Lasa tumbraŋ patumba minna.
Ham tuku ndare ta taŋamba ndo. Nane tuku tumbraŋ yimyam, ma tugu yimyam, pasa mata yimyam.
Sem tuku ndare
Yafet aba nuŋe Sem nu Hibru mbal ŋakmba tuku mbuŋ naŋgine.
Sem tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe tuku nyu ta teŋenmba. Elam, Asur, Arpaksad, Lud, Aram. Ŋgumneŋga nane tuku ndare tugekinaig sulumba mbuŋ kat naŋgine tuku nyu ta tumba naŋgine tumbraŋ yimyam kilmba minnaig.
Aram tuku mbuŋ ta Us mbal Hul mbal Geter mbal Mesek mbal.
Arpaksad tuku kiŋo nuŋe nyunu Sela. Sela tuku kiŋo nuŋe nyunu Eber.
Eber nu kiŋo armba kile-patikina ta ande nyunu Pelek. Pelek tuku ait mbolŋge taŋgo pino ŋakmba sili-silinaig. Eber tuku kiŋo ande nyunu Yoktan.

Yoktan tuku mbuŋ ta Almodad mbal Selef mbal Hasarmawet mbal Yera mbal Hadoram mbal Usal mbal Dikla mbal Obal mbal Abimael mbal Seba mbal Ofir mbal Awila mbal Yobab mbal. Nane ŋakmba Yoktan tuku ndare.
Nane tuku ma tugu makenu ta Mesaŋge tiŋga laipmba kumba ka Sefarŋge tiŋgina. Sefar tumbraŋ ma taknu ki prote kumamŋge minna.
Sem tuku ndare ta taŋamba ndo. Nane tuku tumbraŋ yimyam, ma tugu yimyam, pasa mata yimyam.
Taŋgo kuasmbi ŋakmba ta Noa tuku ndare. Kule suŋgo kugana le Noa tuku kiŋo kat nuŋe tuku ndare puluka tugekina. Nane keŋ ta kilke mbol mbal ŋakmba tuku mbuŋ kat naŋgine.
